help.zeppelin.title: Zeppelin
help.zeppelin.text.me:
This is one of your <0>Zeppelins</0>. 
Each player has 3 <0>Zeppelins</0> (with a resistance value from 1 to 3).

When your opponent places a <0>Bombard</0> card in the column of this <0>Zeppelin</0>, they bombard it. 

To destroy it, your opponent must have a number of <0>Bombard</0> cards in the column >= resistance value of your <0>Zeppelin</0>.

If a player destroys their opponent's 3 <0>Zeppelins</0>, they immediately win the game
help.zeppelin.text:
This is one of {owner}'s <0>Zeppelins</0>. 
Each player has 3 <0>Zeppelins</0> (with a resistance value from 1 to 3).

When you place a <0>Bombard</0> card in the column of this <0>Zeppelin</0>, you bombard it. 

To destroy it, you must have a number of <0>Bombard</0> cards in the column >= resistance value of the <0>Zeppelin</0>.

If a player destroys their opponent's 3 <0>Zeppelins</0>, they immediately win the game

help.play.title: Play effect
help.play.bombard:
<0>Bombard</0>: target the Zeppelin of the opposite column. The opponent sees the resistance value present on the face-down side of their Zeppelin.

If the resistance value is lower or equal to the number of <1/> cards in the opposite column : the Zeppelin card is turned destroyed-face up. <0>If a Guest was present on this Zeppelin, they are removed from the game.</0>
help.play.boarding: <0>Board</0>: discard the last card in the opposite column, without applying its discard effect.
help.play.fishing: <0>Fish</0>: reclaim the first card from your discard pile and add it to your hand.
help.play.strengthen: <0>Strengthen</0>: draw the first card from your Crew deck and add it to your hand.
help.play.secure: <0>Secure</0>: place the last card of one of your adjacent columns face-down in your Treasure.
help.play.gold:
These cards have no play effect.
These cards only have value in your Treasure.
help.discard.title: Discard effect
help.discard.crack: <0>Crack the chest</0>: place the top card of your opponent's Treasure in their discard pile.
help.discard.manoeuvre: <0>Manoeuvre</0>: move the last card in one of your columns to an adjacent column, but <0>don't activate its play effect</0>.
help.discard.recall: <0>Recall</0>: reclaim the last card from one of your columns and add it to your hand.
help.discard.observe: <0>Observe</0>: look at the first 2 cards in your Crew deck and choose for each card whether to leave it on top or put it underneath, in the order of your choice.
help.discard.loot: <0>Loot</0>: place the top card of the opponent's discard pile face down in your Treasure.
help.discard.gold: These cards can't be discarded using the "Discard a card" action.

help.prestigious-guest.title: Prestige Guest
help.prestigious-guest:
When you meet the conditions indicated on the card, you secure it: the Guest is placed in your Treasure.
<0>This card cannot be discarded from your Treasure, and neither can any of the cards under it</0>.

tuto.goal.1: In this game, the <0>Octopirates</0> and the <0>Catmurai</0> compete to become the richest pirates!
tuto.goal.2: <0>Goal</0>: <0>be the richest</0> at the end of the game, or <0>destroy all 3 opposing Zeppelins</0>.
tuto.you: This is <0>your Banner</0>. You play as the Catmurai.
tuto.deck: To the left is <0>your Crew cards deck</0>.
tuto.discard: To the right is <0>your Crew cards discard pile</0>. There are 5 cards in it at the start of the game.
tuto.hand: This is <0>your hand of Crew cards</0>.
tuto.zeppelin: Here are <0>your 3 Zeppelins</0>. They face your opponent's 3 Zeppelins.
tuto.draw: Let's start with the simplest action: draw a card from your deck and place it in your hand.
tuto.place: As a second action, play this green card in your left Zeppelin.
tuto.effect:
When you play a card, you must apply its <0>play effect</0>. If you can't apply its effect, you can't play it.
The green card allows you to <0>pick a card</0>.
tuto.opponent.action.1: Your opponent has played <0>a Treasure card</0>. Treasure cards have no play effect.
tuto.opponent.action.2: As a second action, your opponent has played a brown card. This card allows them to <0>place the last card from one of their Zeppelins in their Treasure</0>.
tuto.opponent.treasure:
This is your opponent's <0>Treasure</0>. The cards are face down.
At the end of the game, <0>the player with the most Gold coins wins</0>... unless their 3 Zeppelins are destroyed first!
The coin value of each card is shown at the top of the card.
tuto.column.rule:
It's your turn to play. When you place a card, <0>you cannot play it in the column with the most cards</0>.
Place this red card in the middle.
tuto.bombard: The red card play effect <0>Bombards the opposing Zeppelin</0>. This is the only way to destroy their Zeppelins.
tuto.zeppelin.value:
Zeppelins have a <0>resistance value</0> between 1 and 3.
All it takes is one bomb to destroy the Zeppelin with resistance 1 that was standing there! It is turned face-up to indicate that it has been destroyed.
tuto.zeppelin.destroy: Your opponent will still be able to play cards in this column, but <0>if you destroy their 3 Zeppelins, you immediately win the game</0>!
tuto.purple:
You have one action left. Place your purple card.
<0>You have to place it in the right-hand column, as the other 2 columns have the most cards.</0>
tuto.discard.get: The play effect of the purple card allows you to <0>reclaim the first card from your discard pile into your hand.</0>
tuto.green: Now it's your turn. Place a green card in the left-hand column.
tuto.draw.2: You've drawn <0>2 cards</0>! That's because when you place a card, you apply its play effect <0>as many times as there are cards of that color in the column</0>.
tuto.discard.3: Beware: if you have 3 identical cards, you apply the play effect 3 times and then <0>you must discard all the cards in the column</0>.
tuto.guest: To destroy an opponent's Zeppelin with resistance 2, you'll need 2 red cards in its column. And 3 red cards for the Zeppelin with resistance 3.
tuto.guest.condition: Finally, here are the <0>Prestige Guests</0> cards. Each Zeppelin has one.
tuto.guest.secure:
Each Prestige Guest has a specific requirement in order to be <0>secured</0>.
For example, this one requires 3 green cards in the column: you're only missing one.
tuto.guest.treasure: Once secured, <0>the Prestige Guest goes into your Treasure</0>. What's more, it can never be discarded from your Treasure, nor can any cards under it.
tuto.guest.lost: If a Zeppelin is destroyed before the Guest is secured, the Guest is lost.
tuto.end.condition: The game ends when a player loses their 3rd Zeppelin, or <0>when a player has no cards left in their deck</0>. In the latter case, their opponent plays a final round, and if both players still have at least one Zeppelin, the richer player wins.
tuto.click: To discover the card effects, you can <0>click on them at any time</0>.
tuto.go: Now you're on your own. Good luck, Catmurai!
